rules.title: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization – annual maximum allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases cannot exceed the lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of the CPI change. The maximum allowable increase for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 is 2.87%. Tenants may petition for review of excess increases, rent reductions for decreased services or habitability failures, and to contest capital improvement pass-throughs.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change per year; 2.87% for 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance. This page does not state which buildings are covered or exempt.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.penalty: Tenant may file a petition for review of a rent increase exceeding the maximum allowable increase.

rules.title: Santa Ana Just Cause Eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict, such as nonpayment of rent, breach of the lease, or owner move-in. For certain eviction reasons, the landlord may have to pay relocation assistance toward moving costs.
rules.key_value: Just cause required for eviction; relocation assistance for certain eviction reasons
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance. This page does not state coverage details.
